name: Central Global Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为股份分拆、新股发行融资及董事委员会成员变动，未披露各业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约信息。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly covered share subdivision, new share issuance for fundraising, and changes in board committee members. No information was disclosed regarding expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contracts for any business segment.
